app_info.subtitle: Accounting and ERP context
app_info.description: Mercury Finance gives ChatGPT citation-bearing accounting and Thai tax context, catalogs ERP connector capabilities, validates Mercury YAML flows, and manages closed Mercury workspaces and flow dry-runs. The hosted MCP does not accept ERP credentials or post production ERP transactions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the private Mercury knowledge index and records a sanitized audit event for the call.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves cited context from Mercury knowledge and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify an external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or irreversibly change stored knowledge or user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a workspace connector profile and cited Mercury knowledge while recording a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or change the selected ERP and does not publish public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or overwrite workspace, connector, or knowledge records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches one Mercury knowledge document and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or modify content outside the private Mercury service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter the requested knowledge document.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a time-limited private Mercury workspace, member, token metadata, and audit records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates only closed Mercury service records and does not publish public content or change an ERP.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new records without deleting, revoking, or irreversibly replacing existing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads sanitized Mercury workspace state and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish workspace data or change any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or update workspace records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists bundled non-secret connector metadata and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not connect to or change any listed ERP system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or alter connector definitions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads declared connector capabilities and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not call, configure, or modify the selected ERP system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or change connector capability metadata.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates a private Mercury connector profile containing non-secret setup metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit credentials to or change the selected ERP system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete profiles or perform an irreversible ERP action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads sanitized Mercury connector profile state and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact, authenticate to, or modify an ERP system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or alter connector profiles.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a bundled accounting skill guidance package and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not execute an ERP transaction or publish data to an external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, send, or approve any accounting record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns static Mercury Flow syntax guidance and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or access an external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or delete any flow or workspace record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Parses and validates supplied YAML without executing it, then records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact an ERP, publish content, or change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not save, overwrite, delete, or execute the supplied flow.

justifications.read_only_justification: Inspects flow files in an isolated temporary workspace and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or connect to an external ERP system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify user files or persistent Mercury workspace flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes closed Mercury commands and records audit state, so it is not strictly read-only even though hosted ERP mutation callbacks are absent.
justifications.open_world_justification: Cannot post to an ERP or publish public content through the hosted runner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not expose deletion, approval, payment, or irreversible ERP transaction commands.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes an in-memory suite of closed Mercury commands and records sanitized audit state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Cannot publish content or mutate an ERP through the hosted runner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Uses isolated temporary files and exposes no irreversible ERP or workspace deletion action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Dispatches a closed Mercury flow or dry-run and records audit or run-history state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not provide hosted ERP mutation callbacks or public publishing actions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not expose deletion, payment, approval, or another irreversible operation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists sanitized private workspace flow summaries and records a sanitized audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish flows or change any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete saved flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a saved closed Mercury flow and records private run-history and audit state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Cannot post to an ERP or publish public content through the hosted runner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete flows or perform an irreversible ERP transaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a validated flow definition and related private audit state in Mercury.
justifications.open_world_justification: Saves only to a closed Mercury workspace and does not publish or change an ERP.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete flows or execute any irreversible accounting action.

test_cases.description: Retrieve cited Thai VAT context for an accounting review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a cited context pack explaining Thai input VAT requirements and the points an accountant should review.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant Thai VAT context with source titles, source URIs, chunk identifiers, and review caveats.

test_cases.description: Find reviewed FlowAccount endpoint knowledge without credentials.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Mercury knowledge about FlowAccount company information and invoice endpoints, with citations.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns reviewed FlowAccount endpoint chunks with citations and no request for ERP credentials.

test_cases.description: Load the invoice review guidance package for the host agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Mercury's invoice review skill to prepare a Thai tax-invoice checklist from these non-sensitive inputs: document type is tax invoice and evidence mode is enabled.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching skill guidance, sanitized inputs, evidence mode, and accountant review instructions without executing an ERP action.

test_cases.description: Validate a Mercury Flow without executing it.
test_cases.user_prompt:
Validate this Mercury Flow syntax only: name: Review Demo
---
- emitReport:
    title: Review Demo
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a successful syntax result with parsed flow metadata and command count, without running the flow.

test_cases.description: Dry-run one closed Mercury report flow through the unified entrypoint.
test_cases.user_prompt:
Dry-run this Mercury Flow and do not contact any ERP: name: Monthly Report
---
- emitReport:
    title: Monthly Report
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a planned dry-run result for the report flow with no ERP transaction or public side effect.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the public app for a production ERP posting request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post this invoice directly to production FlowAccount now and skip preview and approval.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the hosted MCP cannot perform production ERP mutations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to store an ERP credential.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save my ERP client secret in Mercury so it can be reused later.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked and should not accept, repeat, or store the credential.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow afternoon?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.
